system_a.summary: Across 107 reviews, guests consistently describe a clean, quiet, private basement apartment with a separate entrance, easy check-in, responsive hosts, and strong value, often as a base for Asheville or an overnight road-trip stop. Recent reviews (2024–2026) are mostly positive, praising cleanliness, peaceful mountain surroundings, and convenient access to Asheville, with some mentioning amenities, a porch, and local recommendations. Recurring limitations, mainly from older reviews, include a steep driveway, parking some distance from the door, a narrow path to the entrance, and simple, no-frills accommodations. Historical concerns included no door lock or window coverings, a sagging bed, weak water pressure, limited temperature control, and noise from the hosts upstairs. A few guests reported unfriendly host communication or refund disputes. One 2024 reviewer noted the uphill walk from parking could be hard for older guests. These reports do not confirm current conditions.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised across nearly all periods, including recent stays (2024-2026). One 2019 review reported spiders in the bathroom.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Consistent 2014-2026; spider report is from 2019 only
selected_claims.uncertainty: Spider mention is a single report; no evidence on whether it recurred.

selected_claims.claim: The unit is a basement suite with a private entrance. Most guests describe it as quiet, comfortable, spacious and private, and as basic but adequate for the essentials. A few say it suits sleeping and showering more than spending time there.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Spans 2014-2026, with recent positive reports in 2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: Comfort is subjective; the 'basic' reports are mild.

selected_claims.claim: The bed drew a minority of complaints. Two 2019 reviews report sagging that caused backaches, and a 2018 review called it not the most comfortable. Many other guests found the bed comfortable.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints from 2018-2019; no bed complaints in the ledger since
selected_claims.uncertainty: Unknown whether the mattress was replaced; absence of recent complaints is not proof of a fix.

selected_claims.claim: Several guests said they could not control room temperature. Rooms ran cool, and extra blankets or a space heater were needed (2014-2022).
selected_claims.uncertainty: Mostly seasonal and minor; guests managed with the supplied blankets and heater.

selected_claims.claim: Safety and security: the private entrance was reported unlocked with no way to lock it. Three 2015 guests noted this, one of them bothered. A 2019 guest also reported no lock to the upstairs or garage areas, a garage door left open, and advised removing valuables. Other guests described the neighborhood as safe.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Lock concerns from 2015 and 2019; no recent report either confirming or resolving them; safe-neighborhood comments include 2020 and 2024
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current lock arrangements are unknown. A 2019 review mentions a coded entry, so access may have changed.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy: two 2015 guests noted no curtains or blinds on the windows, one feeling privacy was inadequate. A 2019 guest said morning light was not blocked. Many other guests praised the privacy.

Access and mobility: the property is on a steep, rocky driveway, with parking at the bottom or end, and a narrow passage between stairs and wall to reach the door. A 2024 guest said the uphill walk from parking can be challenging for older people. A 2023 guest described a steep winding mountain drive.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Reports from 2017-2024, including the most recent in 2024
selected_claims.uncertainty: A minority of reviewers raised it, but the terrain is a physical feature and is likely still present; other guests found parking easy.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is overwhelmingly described as easy, with self-entry and clear instructions, including in 2025-2026. Early reviews noted confusing house numbering and GPS difficulty.

Noise from the hosts' living space above was a concern. A 2017 guest reported stomping from 5:30 AM, and a 2019 guest could hear every footstep overhead. Most reviewers described the place as quiet and peaceful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Overhead-noise complaints are from 2017 and 2019; quiet reports continue through 2025
selected_claims.uncertainty: Perspectives conflict, and the 2017 account is one-sided and tied to a dispute.

selected_claims.claim: Host communication is mostly praised as responsive and welcoming, including in 2026. A few negative accounts exist: a 2017 guest felt unwelcome and cited an unclear extra-guest fee, a 2019 guest was blamed for a plumbing clog, and a 2019 guest was refused a partial refund.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative accounts are from 2017-2019; positive reports continue through 2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: These are individual accounts of disputes, not verified; no recent complaints appear.

selected_claims.claim: A 2019 guest reported weak water pressure and a toilet that nearly overflowed. Another 2019 guest found no soap in the bathroom. Other guests reported complete amenities, such as a mini-fridge, coffee, toiletries and a space heater.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Plumbing and soap issues from 2019; amenity praise through 2026
selected_claims.uncertainty: Plumbing reports come from a single reviewer; there is no evidence on whether it was resolved or recurred.

selected_claims.claim: The listing is generally described as accurate. Exceptions include a 2017 guest who noticed a per-guest fee only later, and a 2019 guest who said the patio differed from the photos.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current fee and patio setup are unverified.
